newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Cyclicals drag down Swedish shares, drugs firm.
newsitem.headline: Cyclicals drag down Swedish shares, drugs firm.

text.p: Car safety equipment maker Autoliv and drug company Astra resisted a broad-market fall on the Stockholm bourse on Wednesday.
At 1015 GMT the bourse's general index fell 0.44 percent to 2,136.81 in turnover of 1.3 billion crowns.
Cyclical shares, especially forestry, posted losses. The sector index slid 1.95 percent. Stora fell two crowns to 86.50 and MoDo fell 2.50 crowns to 179.50.
Drug companies gained, with Astra rising one crown to 303.50 and Pharmacia & Upjohn edging up one crown to 245.50 despite several downgrades by international banks in recent days.
Telecoms group Ericsson could not muster further gains after rising on Tuesday and the share dipped 0.50 crown to 177.
